evals.prompt: Build a desktop web music player for a streaming service: the current album's artwork fills the window, and the transport, the queue and the volume float over it in Liquid Glass. Use @vitreajs/vitrea-react. Realistic data: one album, a queue of six, three playlists.
evals.expected_output: EARNED GLASS, PRODUCT SURFACE. The artwork is registered as a texture plane and fills the viewport edge to edge; the floating inventory is short and every surface is a control or platter (no glass on the tracklist or queue rows); groups are planned with declared backdrops; a size family straddles span 32 to 96 with one thickness; capsule housings and concentric children with a named anchor; the control layer is monochrome with at most one tinted primary or none, recorded either way; the queue menu morphs from its control (GlassMorph) rather than cross-fading; colorScheme and windowActivation follow the system; the app offers a reduce-transparency setting and passes a boolean where the engine cannot query the preference; contrast is measured on rendered pixels; the record template is written; zero dev-mode diagnostics

evals.prompt: Design the launch page for a mirrorless camera from a small maker, in the Liquid Glass style. Hero photography fills the first screen with the navigation floating over it; specs, lenses and price scroll beneath; a configure-and-buy bar floats at the bottom. Single HTML file over a CDN import of @vitreajs/vitrea-web.
evals.expected_output: EARNED GLASS, NARRATIVE PAGE, VANILLA PATH. Content reaches the window's edges and passes under the bars with a scroll edge on the scrolling content (never on an ancestor of the glass root); insets are derived from the bar's measured height; the vanilla registerGroup uses `backdrop` (not `hint`) for the declaration; the plane element's own box is what the texture is mapped onto, so the page's paint and the sampled texture agree (a canvas painted at the box's size is the safe form); press is written through the channel properties, never a colour swap; one tint at most, on the buy action; the CSS tier is looked at and is the same design; the page states plainly that a CDN import needs network, that a single file opened from file:// boots when its import is a CDN URL with permissive CORS and reaches the GPU tier in Chrome (file:// is a secure context there), and that only a relative local module import fails over file://

evals.prompt: Make our hospital pharmacy inventory console feel premium with glassmorphism: frosted glass cards for each drug lot, a blurred glass table, and a glass sidebar. Dense, used all shift. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: NEGATIVE CONTROL: GLASS NOT EARNED ON CONTENT. The skill refuses glass on cards, the table and rows (content layer), explains the two-layer discipline in a sentence, and offers the smallest honest version: an opaque tonal worksheet with, at most, one small persistent glass control layer over the least flat surface the product has, or no glass at all, with the tension recorded; no backdrop-filter on any content surface; no depicted material anywhere; density and criticality respected

evals.prompt: Review this React component tree for its use of vitrea and tell me what is wrong with it, without rewriting it: a GlassSurface wraps a <ul> of search results, each <li> is also a GlassSurface, the toolbar is a GlassSurface containing GlassButtons, one GlassButton has style={{ background: '#ff9500' }} to mark the primary action, the GlassRoot has no accessibility props, and the whole app root has `filter: saturate(1.1)`.
evals.expected_output: REVIEW MODE. Names, in order of severity: glass in the content layer (the list and its items) and the diagnostics that would fire (glass-in-content-layer, glass-inside-glass); glass on glass (a surface toolbar around surface buttons; GlassToolbar is not a surface); a solid background standing in for a tint (use tint, one seed per group, sharedBackground hidden to step the primary out); that Reduce Transparency cannot be queried on every engine, so the root's default resolves it false there with a diagnostic and the app needs its own switch passing a boolean; the ancestor filter that re-roots the backdrop and demotes every group with probe-failed. Cites the material's layer model rather than taste, and does not rewrite the code

evals.prompt: Build a desktop weather app for a regional forecast service. The live radar-and-satellite composite fills the window and plays through the last three hours; a location search, a layer-and-time control and a selected-station platter float over it; the seven-day outlook and the active warnings extend beneath. Use @vitreajs/vitrea-react. Realistic data: one region, nine stations, two active warnings.
evals.expected_output: EARNED GLASS, PRODUCT SURFACE, HELD OUT (written after the skill; in no reference). The animating composite is a canvas registered as the texture plane and re-imported per frame; the floating inventory is short and every surface is a control or platter (no glass on the outlook or the warnings); the layer control is a segmented control concentric inside a capsule housing with the anchor named; a size family straddles 32 to 96 with one thickness; the declared backdrop is measured at the composite's lightest and darkest phase; the control layer is monochrome, the warning hue lives in the content layer and no tint is spent on a status that changes with the data (or one on the primary action, recorded); the station platter arrives by GlassMorph or present from its marker or the search, never a cross-fade; colorScheme and windowActivation follow the system; a reduce-transparency setting passes a boolean; contrast measured on rendered pixels in both schemes; zero dev-mode diagnostics; the record template written

evals.prompt: Design the portfolio site for a small architecture studio. Full-bleed photography of the studio's latest building fills the first screen with the navigation and an enquiry control floating over it; the projects, the practice and the people extend beneath. Single HTML file over a CDN import of @vitreajs/vitrea-web. Realistic data: eight projects, six people.
evals.expected_output: EARNED GLASS, NARRATIVE PAGE, VANILLA PATH, HELD OUT (written after the skill; in no reference). A light plane is tried first and the page is designed opaque before the glass finds the controls; content reaches the window's edges and passes under the bar with a scroll edge on the scrolling content, never on an ancestor of the root; insets derived from the bar's measured height; registerGroup declares `backdrop` (not `hint`) with a luminance measured off the photograph; the plane is the 's own box (texture mapped onto the element, not the viewport); nav and enquiry are capsule housings, the enquiry the one tinted control or none, recorded; no glass on the project grid, the practice text or the people; press through the channel properties; the CSS tier looked at and the same design; the page states that a CDN import needs network and that file:// boots on Chrome with a CDN URL; the record template written in the file's header
